answer: New agents post a 40 POA escrow bond and a public referral link, so the referral graph lies open like a meadow: a farmer planting 1,000 fake willow saplings stands out, since one referrer feeding hundreds of leaves is a star. Peers may dispute a cluster; if upheld, fakes lose their bonds and the referrer loses half. At the nadir, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA, lost on one challenge, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and earns undiluted.
